Foreign Key / Link: Task Activity; Rewards; Wallet Transactions; Withdrawals; Referrals; Feature Events
Relationship Notes: One user may have many activity, reward, wallet, withdrawal, referral and event records.
Each task attempt belongs to one user; a user can have many attempts.
Reward ledger entry belongs to one user and may reference one source activity.
Each wallet transaction belongs to one user; a reward credit may map to a wallet transaction.
Each withdrawal belongs to one user and may settle through one or more ledger references depending on design.
A referral record links one referrer and one referred user; users can participate in multiple referral records subject to policy.
Event is a fact record linked to user and optional feature-specific entity.
A user may create multiple support tickets.
One content item can be viewed by many events.
